visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female baseball player wearing a white and red Sun Star jersey with the number 51 stands at home plate holding a baseball bat. She adjusts her black batting helmet and prepares her stance under bright daylight. Teammates are visible in the background dugout behind a blue 'momo' banner. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot where she begins her swing, but quickly stops with a look of confusion. The camera zooms in on her face as she looks around, clearly missing the action or pitch. Yellow and white text overlays appear on the screen to highlight her bewilderment. (3) A close-up shot follows as she tilts her head with a puzzled expression. A large blue question mark graphic is edited above her head. She continues to look toward the pitcher's mound, blinking in surprise at the empty space where she expected the ball to be.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, upbeat synth-brass music plays as an excited male announcer shouts over a stadium speaker system. The sound of a cheering crowd and a faint wooden thud of a bat can be heard. (2) A sharp transition 'whoosh' occurs, instantly cutting the music to silence. This is followed by a comical 'boing' cartoon sound effect and a short, confused three-note musical jingle indicating a 'fail' or humorous mistake. (3) The comedic stinger continues with a light, playful percussion rhythm while distant ambient stadium chatter and wind noise fill the background, emphasizing the silence following the batter's confusion.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain viewers by highlighting a humorous, relatable moment of confusion from a celebrity baseball player during a game, using meme-style editing and sound effects to amplify the comedic timing.
